payoff_identity.exclusions: best-model events use a different Models-view ranking and are excluded; Other, Company-letter placeholders, and the ByteDance/Bytedance spelling mismatch are excluded because cross-event identity is not source-proved
payoff_identity.package: NO(named company is second) plus NO(the same named company is third)
payoff_identity.price_gate: conservative second NO proxy one minus second YES bestBid plus conservative third NO proxy one minus third YES bestBid must be strictly below one pUSD, then remain positive after exact current fees and one adverse tick per leg
payoff_identity.proof: one named company cannot occupy both deterministic ordinal positions in one common total ranking; if it is second, third-NO pays one, if it is third, second-NO pays one, otherwise both pay one
payoff_identity.selection: enumerate all 67 frozen named-identity packages across all four families before one deterministic global ranking
